name: system-doctor
description: All-in-one system optimizer and autonomous SRE diagnostic engine (CleanMyMac X meets Site Reliability Engineering). Auto-detects device signatures in 0.1s (macOS, Linux Server/NAS, Workstation) to clean OS/developer caches, purge RAM, kill runaway CPU hogs, hunt port conflicts, inspect Docker crashloops, and execute 1-click auto-healing.
